title: Seed.locale: marketplace install, reseed sample data and per-org replay should select datasets by the installing organization's locale
body:
## Source

Asked by HotCRM's maintainer, who wants Chinese customers to get Chinese demo data when they install HotCRM. Ruled option A on 2026-11-05: the platform's install paths pick datasets by locale, and HotCRM ships zh-CN datasets. The maintainer set every card of this work to priority p1.

## Problem (measured on 18.3.0 and objectstack main 797f9257)

`Seed.locale` (#16595) lets an app ship one demo dataset per language market. The only place it is read is `AppPlugin.resolveSeedLocale()` (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`). That method reads the bundle's static `i18n.defaultLocale`, and three call sites use it: the boot seed, the per-org `seed-replayer` (captured once at boot), and dev hot-reload.

These paths pass no locale:
- marketplace install, `reseed-sample-data` and the rehydrate healer (`runInlineSeed` in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`);
- package apply and draft publish.

When a locale-scoped dataset reaches one of them, every dataset loads and the loader logs a warning. The spec records this as a decision (`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`, `locale` doc: "Publishing and installing are locale-neutral acts", ruled on #17011, 2026-09-10).

As a result, an app cannot give a Chinese tenant Chinese sample data from one package. Two things happen instead:
- if the app adds `locale: ['zh-CN']` datasets, every marketplace tenant gets both the English and the Chinese rows;
- one server's per-org replay gives every organization the same boot locale.

The tenant setting `localization.locale` (service-settings, `scope: 'tenant'`) already exists. The seed path never reads it.

## Ask (maintainer ruling 2026-11-05, Irene, option A; reverses #17011's install-path bound)

1. Marketplace install, reseed sample data and the rehydrate healer pass a locale to the seed load request: the installing organization's effective `localization.locale` (cascade platform → global → tenant), or else the installing user's `sys_user.locale`, or else the app's `i18n.defaultLocale`.
2. The per-org `seed-replayer` resolves the locale per organization, not once at boot.
3. Decide what happens at new-org founding, when the replay fires on `sys_organization` insert, possibly before the org has a `localization.locale`. Options:
   - (a) use the founding user's `sys_user.locale`;
   - (b) defer the replay until the locale is set;
   - (c) fall back to `i18n.defaultLocale` and let the tenant reseed later.
4. Keep the existing behaviour for datasets without `locale`: they stay unrestricted.

## Consumer

hotcrm: zh-CN product catalogue and standard price book (`SaasTenantSeedData`), as `locale: ['zh-CN']` datasets beside the English ones. The hotcrm change merges only after a pinned release carries this card. Until then, marketplace tenants would seed both languages.
